advisory_notes: The source extract supports the 2 November 2026 release date and substantive result details, but the note’s officialFacts section incorrectly says the source supplies only the title and no result particulars.
The claim that UPSC is established under Article 315 is supported by the official UPSC search result.[1]
The proposed GS2.3, GS2.8 and GS3.8 tagging is broadly defensible, but GS3.8 is an indirect linkage rather than a direct syllabus match.
The phrase “merit-based route” is analytical shorthand; the result establishes competitive selection, not that merit alone determines final service entry.
The phrase “constitutional recruitment” is useful framing, but UPSC’s constitutional status does not make every CDS selection step constitutional or exclusively UPSC-controlled.
The pocketRead title says “UPSC declares final result,” while the supplied document is a PIB release reporting the declaration; this is acceptable shorthand but could identify PIB more precisely.

The pocketRead statement that the source “does not support conclusions about selections” is too broad: the extract explicitly states that 243 candidates qualified, while it does not establish appointment or training completion.
The “illustration” is clearly labelled and therefore should not be read as a real event; its administrative analogy is sound.

wayForward: Maintain transparent, accessible and auditable recruitment procedures.
Report examination results separately from later medical, verification, appointment and training stages.
Use official primary documents before asserting vacancies, candidate numbers or institutional outcomes.
Assess recruitment reforms through fairness, timeliness, integrity and suitability for service.
